T013 : ∀ (n : ℕ) (E : Set (V n)),
  (n = 0 → dimH (_root_.cylinder E) ≤ dimH E + 1) →
    (1 ≤ n →
        ∀ (q δ ε : ℝ),
          dimH E < ENNReal.ofReal q →
            0 < δ →
              0 < ε →
                ∃ W, scaleCover δ (_root_.cylinder E) W ∧ cost (q + 1) W < ENNReal.ofReal (2 * √2 ^ (q + 1) * ε)) →
      ScaleLaws ∧ CriticalLaws ∧ InvarianceLaws ∧ PowerLaws →
        ((0 ≤ dimH E ∧ dimH E ≤ ↑n) ∧
            dimH E ≠ ∞ ∧
              Bornology.IsBounded E ∧
                (∃ R, 1 ≤ R ∧ ∀ x ∈ E, ∀ (j : Fin n), |x.ofLp j| ≤ R) ∧
                  (∀ (s δ : ℝ), 0 < s → 0 < δ → content s δ E < ∞) ∧
                    (n = 0 → E = univ ∧ dimH E = 0) ∧
                      (Function.Bijective fun p => join p.1 p.2) ∧
                        (∀ (x : V n) (t : ℝ), base (join x t) = x ∧ height (join x t) = t) ∧
                          (∀ (z : V (n + 1)), join (base z) (height z) = z) ∧
                            ∀ (x y : V n) (t u : ℝ), dist (join x t) (join y u) ^ 2 = dist x y ^ 2 + dist t u ^ 2) →
          dimH (_root_.cylinder E) ≤ dimH E + 1
'Translation.T013' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
